title: Tonbankcard Governance Activation Manifest (E1)
description: Canonical, append-only layout for `docs/governance/E1-activation/activations/<timestamp>.json` files committed at the close of E1 Phase 4. The manifest records the single on-chain write that activates governance — the `SnapshotVerifier.set_registry` binding — together with the upstream-gate evidence required to consider that write safe. Mainnet activation manifests are never edited or deleted; corrections add a new manifest that references the prior one via `supersedes`. The file is the source of truth referenced by `STATUS.md` §6, `docs/deployments/network-matrix.md` (governance group `activated: yes`), and `docs/existing-contracts.md`.

version.description: Schema version; bump only via a new E-track engagement.

manifestType.description: Static type tag used by tooling to reject foreign files. Distinct from B2's `tonbankcard.deploy.manifest`.

network.description: E1 mainnet activation only. Testnet round-trip evidence lives in `TESTNET_VALIDATION.md` §4 — not in this manifest.

environment.description: Always `mainnet`. Tooling rejects any other value for E1 activations.

engagementId.description: Fixed for the first activation cycle. Subsequent engagement IDs use new manifest schemas, not new values here.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the activation manifest was finalised; matches the filename.

commit.description: Full git SHA of the commit that introduces this manifest. Used by `scripts/governance/verify-parameters.ts` to pin the `PARAMETERS.md` / `SNAPSHOT.md` content this manifest ratifies.

evidence.description: Path or URL to A1 STATUS attestation showing verdict `READY` for Phase 2 contracts (incl. governance group).
Path or URL to B2 STATUS showing verdict `MAINNET-LIVE` after the 24-hour soak window.

manifestPath.description: Path of the B2 mainnet manifest that records the governance group with `governanceActivated: false`.

criticalFindings.description: Must be exactly 0 — any Critical finding aborts the engagement (verdict `ABORTED`).

reportPath.description: Path of the testnet round-trip report (typically `audit/governance-snapshots/E1-PROP-000-testnet.json`).

reviewerGithubLogin.description: GitHub login of the second pair of eyes. Must NOT equal the maintainer.

reviewUrl.description: URL of the PR review marking `PARAMETERS.md` + `SNAPSHOT.md` as approved.

dashboardUrl.description: URL or path to the B3 staging dashboard screenshot proving governance events mirror end-to-end.

alertRulesArmed.description: Names of armed alert rules. Must include `R-014 GovernanceEventGap`.

cooldownEndAt.description: `T₀ + 24h`. The snapshot block must have `gen_utime >= cooldownEndAt`.

txHash.description: Mainnet transaction hash of the `set_registry` send. Must equal `setRegistry.txHash` below.

prUrl.description: URL of the PR that introduces THIS manifest AND flips governance group `activated: yes` in `network-matrix.md` in the same commit.

upstreamGates.description: Evidence for the ten upstream gates of `ENGAGEMENT.md` §4 and `STATUS.md` §2. All ten must be `passed` at activation time; any `pending` entry indicates an aborted manifest (`paused: true`).

contracts.description: Mainnet addresses for the three governance contracts. All three are read from the active B2 mainnet manifest — E1 does NOT redeploy; it activates.

txHash.description: Mainnet transaction hash of the `set_registry` send. Identical to `upstreamGates.G9_setRegistryBinding.txHash`.

block.description: Masterchain seqno at which the `set_registry` transaction landed.

submittedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the transaction was broadcast.

confirmedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the chosen confirmation threshold (≥ 32 mc-blocks per RUNBOOK §4.4).

from.description: Sender address. MUST equal the B2 deployer multi-sig (`deployer.multiSigAddress` of the B2 manifest). Anti-foot-gun rule AF-E1-1.

to.description: Recipient address. MUST equal `contracts.snapshotVerifier.address`. Anti-foot-gun rule AF-E1-2.

value.description: Attached TON value in nanograms. MUST be ≤ 100_000_000 (0.1 TON). Anti-foot-gun rule AF-E1-4.

intentBody.description: Plain-text comment body. MUST be exactly `set_registry`. Anti-foot-gun rule AF-E1-3.

signers.description: Hardware-wallet signer addresses that countersigned the multi-sig intent. MUST be a subset of the B2 mainnet manifest `deployer.signers` (E1 does NOT introduce new keys).

confirmations.description: Masterchain block confirmations observed before declaring the binding successful. RUNBOOK §4.4 mandates ≥ 32.

setRegistry.description: The single mainnet write performed by the engagement. The contract correctly rejects any second `set_registry` send with `Registry already set` — accidental re-call is a CRITICAL incident per RUNBOOK §8.

enabled.description: Indexer governance pipeline flipped from `staging` to `mainnet`. Must be `true` for a passing activation.

mirroredEvents.description: Event types the mainnet indexer is now subscribed to. Must include all four — partial coverage is rejected.

dashboardUrl.description: Path or URL to the production B3 dashboard panel `Governance — events / hour`.

indexerActivation.description: Indexer state immediately after activation. The indexer is the only off-chain consumer that maintains the `TransparencyRegistry` mirror; without it `governanceActivated: yes` would be a lie.

getProposalRegistry.description: RUNBOOK §4.5 row 1 — proves the binding landed where intended. A mismatch is CRITICAL.

doubleBindRejected.description: RUNBOOK §4.5 row 2 — proves the contract enforces one-time binding. Result obtained via RPC dry-run; no second on-chain send is performed.

windowEnd.description: Must be ≥ `windowStart + 1h`. No B3 alerts fire during this window for the activation to be considered clean.

alertSilenceWindow.description: RUNBOOK §4.5 row 3 — silent dashboard during the binding.

reviewerGithubLogin.description: Verification reviewer. MUST be distinct from the maintainer and from any multi-sig signer.

attestationCommit.description: Commit SHA of the reviewer's `Reviewed-by` trailer in the activation PR.

reviewerAttestation.description: Two-reviewer attestation — append-only manifests have no edit path post-merge.

verification.description: Aggregate verification record proving the binding is wired correctly and that the off-chain pipeline is observing the right contracts.

prUrl.description: URL of the PR that introduces this manifest. MUST be the same PR that flips the matrix; gate G-10 is `atomic`.

commit.description: Commit SHA of the atomic update. Equal to top-level `commit` if a single commit is used.

before.description: All three rows MUST show `activated: no` immediately before the matrix update.

after.description: All three rows MUST show `activated: yes` immediately after. Partial flips are forbidden — `network-matrix.md` updates atomically per gate G-10.

networkMatrixUpdate.description: The matrix flip is part of the manifest, not a follow-up commit, so reviewers can verify the two changes against each other in a single diff.

dryRun.description: `true` if produced by a dry-run of the activation runbook. Dry-run manifests are NEVER committed under `docs/governance/E1-activation/activations/`.

paused.description: `true` if a CRITICAL incident is detected after merge. Append-only — paused manifests stay in the audit trail; corrections add new manifests via `supersededBy`.

supersedes.description: Filename of the prior activation manifest this one supersedes, or `null` for the first activation.

supersededBy.description: Filename of the follow-up manifest that supersedes this one. `null` while this manifest is current.

address.description: Mainnet contract address copied verbatim from the active B2 manifest. E1 must NOT alter this value.

codeHash.description: SHA-256 of the deployed contract code cell. Must equal the value recorded in the B2 manifest under the same contract name.

deployManifest.description: Path of the B2 mainnet manifest that originally recorded this contract. Used by tooling to back-link to the deployment evidence.

tonviewerUrl.description: Convenience URL to TONviewer for human reviewers.
